nom: TONYMOLY Mask Melt Vitamin C + Rice Overnight Hydrogel Mask

avis.titre: This made my face so glowy!
avis.texte: I had used this face mask the night before my birthday. Oh my gosh, it fit my face perfectly and it was soothing. I would definitely use this again!
really wanted to love it but it just doesn't stay on or fit right. honestly just don't bother
can't walk around wearing it or lay with it on because it'll just slip to one side and youll have to constantly readjust but it just seems unsanitary to have to keep touching my face to fix it
I tried using this as an overnight mask but within the first few minutes it fell off. This is a waste of money if you're going to buy it. I'm lucky mine was free.

Really like this mask. It's my first time using the brand and I'm impressed. I like the melting affect too, haven't used anything like it before. Leaves my akin feeling soft and plump afterwards. Gifted by tonymoly

I absolutely love the Vitamin C & Rice Essence Glowy Melt Mask,, it left my skin looking radiant and feeling deeply hydrated. The texture melts beautifully into the skin — not greasy at all — and gives that fresh, dewy glow that looks like a mini facial in minutes. Gifted by tonymoly

I really enjoyed using this mask. It was the perfect pampering that I needed that was so simple to put on after my nighttime shower and just leave on. I'm not the biggest fan of leaving on overnight because I feel like it's gonna get all over my pillow. Complimentary from tony moly

Love this TONYMOLY Vitamin C mask! It melts into my skin overnight without feeling greasy. I woke up with a smooth and refreshing feeling on my face. Will need more uses to see if it brightens my skin. Complimentary from tonymoly!

Gifted by TONYMOLY. I'm a huge fan of face masks, and this one was such a nice change from the usual sheet masks. The gel texture felt super soothing on my skin, and I loved the light cooling sensation even without putting it in the fridge. I left it on a bit longer than the instructions said (oops), but my skin looked so plump and glowy afterward. I'd definitely repurchase this and can't wait to try more from TONYMOLY!

Really nice face mask, used it overnight and it stayed on my face. It was comfortable and it actually fit my face shape not too big or small. Felt my skin was moisturized and plump the next morning. Will be getting more. Gifted by tonymoly

This face mask left my skin feeling soft, hydrated, and refreshed! Loved the cooling sensation and instant glow after taking it off. Perfect for a quick self-care moment or pre-makeup boost. Highly recommend! gifted by tony moly

Love masks when they have 2 pieces because it just fits my small face so much better. The hydrogel mask is super hydrating and cooling on. My skin looks plump and moisturized right after perfect addition to my skincare routine. I did receive this complimentary from tonymoly.

This is so hydrating and makes my skin feel bouncy and so smooth, it smells good and leaves a nice cooling effect on my skin. I totally recommend this to anyone with dry skin Complimentary from tonymoly

I love all tonymoly masks so I was excited to try this one! It fit my face well and was easy to unfold and did not slide down. I left it on while watching TV and when I took it off, my skin was soft, moisturized and fresh and the serum from the mask soaked in nicely. Gifted by tonymoly

This is a very nice and comfortable mask. It's easy to apply and mess-free. It automatically gives you a feeling of freshness. It did leave my skin feeling and looking smoother, hydrated, and PLUMP! but of course you need to use it more for permanent results. complimentary from Tonymoly.

I absolutely love doing face masks for skin care! It's so relaxing and makes my skin feel great afterwards. This is a fantastic face mask and feels incredible. Overall I would highly recommend trying it out. Gifted by Tonymoly

Tony Moly gifted me thier brightening face mask and i love it!!! I love the jelly texture of the mask but it doesn't slip off the face! My skin is so glowy and bright after using it!! I can't wait to try all the other mask

Tony Moly was my first experience into Korean beauty and this mask was a reminder why I love them so much. The gel melt was exactly what I needed in terms of brightening with my dull-acne prone skin. gifted by tonymoly

I really really liked this it kept my face super hydrated and nice I really do recommend this I would say this is the best mask I ever tried and when I woke up the next morning my face and skin was so nice a hydrated Gifted by tonymoly

I love how soothing and hydrating a hydrogel mask feels! I just got back from camping in the desert, so my skin is in serious need of rehabilitation. This mask does the trick— I'm so happy to have gotten it gifted by TonyMoly!

This face mask is such a treat. It feels cooling right away, super soothing, and leaves my skin soft and refreshed after using. it's perfect for a quick self-care moment when my skin needs a little reset! it was gifted by tony moly.
